title: Homogeneous twist sections cut out standard opens on the invertibility locus
statement: Let $A=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}A_n$ be a nonnegatively graded commutative ring, $P=\operatorname{Proj}(A)$ [def-pc-proj]. Fix $d\geq1$, and let $W_d\subseteq P$ be the largest open subscheme on which every $\mathcal O_P(nd)|_{W_d}$ is invertible and all multiplication maps $\mathcal O_P(nd)|_{W_d}\otimes\mathcal O_P(md)|_{W_d}\to\mathcal O_P((n+m)d)|_{W_d}$ are isomorphisms (equivalently, the union of standard opens $D_+(ab)$ with homogeneous $a,b$ and $\deg(a)=\deg(b)+d$). If $U\subseteq W_d$ is an open subscheme [def-weil-open-immersion] and $f\in A_{nd}$ is homogeneous for some $n\geq1$, let $s_f\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U(nd))$ be the restriction of the canonical section. Then its nonvanishing locus is $U_{s_f}=U\cap D_+(f)$. As $f$ ranges over positive-degree homogeneous elements whose degrees are multiples of $d$ (and their positive powers), these loci form a basis of the topology of $U$; the affine such loci form an affine-open basis.
